title: Veil Discovery Service (VDS) protocol
description: JSON bodies of POST {server}/v1/discovery. See docs/guide/vds.md. A control plane answers a DiscoveryRequest with 200 + DiscoveryResponse, or 304 (empty body) when nothing changed within poll_timeout_secs.

ErrorDetail.description: Present only in a NACK, once. The message is veil's validation error.

RouteResource.description: One [[route]] entry in the same shape as the TOML. Resource order is evaluation order. null values are dropped. A 'name' field is ignored.

UpstreamResource.description: One [upstreams.<name>] table. 'name' is the table name; the other fields are the table (servers, algorithm, health_check, ...). null values are dropped.

version_info.description: Last successfully applied version; empty before the first snapshot.

response_nonce.description: nonce of the last response handled (applied or rejected); empty before the first.

poll_timeout_secs.description: Longest time the server may hold the request.

version_info.description: Opaque version of this snapshot (for example a content hash).

nonce.description: Opaque token echoed back as response_nonce.

type_url.description: Optional; any other value rejects the response.

resources.description: The complete snapshot (State-of-the-World). Empty means no routes and no upstreams. Limited by [vds] max_resources (default 10000).
